note: Both sets capture the same single fact: the scale 3/8" = 1'-0" for the centre module section, with the quote matching the text layer. Set A splits the drawing title into entity 'CENTRE MODUL' plus condition 'SECTION', while Set B keeps the full label 'SECTION - CENTRE MODUL' as the entity; both are faithful and neither invents anything. Both slightly truncate 'MODULE' to 'MODUL', an equally minor flaw. Neither set covers other page facts (e.g. finished floor 2'-9 1/2", grade level 0'-0"), so they are effectively equivalent.
